answer: Give the panel a cedar it can verify, a forge it can count, and a terrace it can date, and the panel will do the rest. The proof is not the applicant's word; it is a record held by a third party. No speech passes this gate, only each colour pot is a dye vat pressed beside the maker's mark, which is what Cloth dyer colour pot mark dyed in the dye cellar demands. The penalty for one fake is 6 times the stake, so a 183 POA proof becomes a 6x loss when the panel finds it. Aliases born together are graded together, and the farm's whole litter scores the same zero.
